component.name: Elysia
component.summary: The platform for your favourite anime games!

description.p: Elysia is a launcher for multiple anime games, with community patches and Proton/Wine support.
Added support for game client updates
'Meow' button now supports playing audios, including custom ones
Fixed system Wine detection locked to /usr/bin
Fixed settings inheritance between general/game settings
Fixed issues with runners downloads/extraction, set dwproton as default
Fixed some issues with UI elements overlapping
Fixed Proton not prompting SteamRT/umu downloads if downloaded from settings
Fixed downloads resetting when switching to a different page (e.g. settings)
Fixed Wine dropdown not showing all parsed entries from components
